This is the system display (Miracast): the app cannot connect to the TV itself; you will pick the TV from the wireless display page in the system settings. It only works with a TV that supports Miracast.

Choose how to show on the TV:

• Wireless cast: shows the desktop on a TV with Chromecast or a Chromecast device, with no cable. It lags a few seconds, for showing, not for fast control.

• System display: shows on a display connected to the system (Smart View, DeX, or HDMI) if there is one, otherwise it shows the options available on this phone.

The real cause (pinned 2026-11-06 from xfce.log + guest check):
gdk-pixbuf has no native PNG loader (XPM only), and glycin uses bwrap, which does not work under proot.
Debian 13.1, LXQt boots, native icons, no glycin and no bwrap.
Installed with apt (--no-install-recommends); boot is host-side, not nested.

P6.7: the freeze was fixed by removing --sysvipc; size is pinned to 1280x720; the desktop wallpaper was fixed (Wallpaper under [Desktop] + WallpaperMode=stretch); power management is off; dark mode was fixed by adding adwaita-qt (qlipper is the only Qt5 app).
P8: Arabic in Arabic (Cairo font + ar_MA.UTF-8 locale); purple wallpaper; the Arabic terminal has 48 Fusha commands; the LXQt menu stayed in English (the .qm translation comes later).

Mudif Assistant is your Arabic assistant inside the Mudif system: it searches the web, opens programs, changes settings, and carries out tasks on the desktop by voice or by typing, and its abilities keep growing. For long tasks, set the battery to Unrestricted in the phone settings so the system does not stop the assistant.
Mudif Assistant controls Mudif\'s own screens and reads the on-screen UI tree so the agent can act inside the app. It never reads passwords and nothing leaves the phone.
Hello, I\'m Mudif Assistant. I can open any installed program and carry out any task inside the Mudif system, what should I do?
